entities.summary: Mirian III, a notable figure in the history of Georgia, associated with Christianization and Early Medieval Georgia (337–500). Preceded by Christianization of Georgia and King Mirian III adopts Christianity as state religion of Iberia. Their legacy influenced Arab Emirate of Tbilisi and Arab.
